text: 华安基金基金经理苏圻涵近日表示，虽然外部扰动与内部结构分化叠加，A股市场的情绪面修复需要一个过程；但从中长期看，目前市场估值、盈利和流动性等因素都支持对中长期方向保持信心。具体来看，估值压力经过本轮调整已得到较大程度释放，10年期国债收益率约1.6%、理财约1%，而沪深300股息率接近3%、ROE接近6%，无论自身估值（含PEG）还是资产间横向比较，均处于较合理的位置。从企业盈利角度看，随着PPI转正，全A非金融企业盈利增速近三年来首次回到双位数增长，按目前三季报披露情况，预计全年增速10%—15%。
text_en: Su Qihan, a fund manager at HuaAn Fund, said recently that although external disturbances and internal structural divergence have combined, sentiment recovery in the A-share market will take time; but from a medium- to long-term perspective, current market valuation, earnings and liquidity factors all support confidence in the medium- to long-term direction. Specifically, valuation pressure has been largely released after this round of adjustment. The 10-year government bond yield is about 1.6%, wealth management products about 1%, while the CSI 300 dividend yield is nearly 3% and ROE nearly 6%. Whether judged by its own valuation (including PEG) or by cross-asset comparison, it is at a relatively reasonable level. From the perspective of corporate earnings, as PPI turns positive, earnings growth of all A-share non-financial companies has returned to double-digit growth for the first time in nearly three years. Based on third-quarter report disclosures so far, full-year growth is expected to be 10%-15%.
